v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Iustórum ánimæ in manu Dei sunt, et non tanget illos torméntum mortis. Visi sunt óculis insipiéntium mori: illi autem sunt in pace.
text.en: But the souls of the just are in the hand of God, and the torment of death shall not touch them. In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die, but they are in peace.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Gaudent in cælis * ánimæ Sanctórum, qui Christi vestígia sunt secúti: et quia pro eius amóre sánguinem suum fudérunt, ídeo cum Christo exsúltant sine fine.
text.en: In heaven do rejoice the souls of the Saints * who have followed the steps of Christ; and because they shed their blood for the love of Christ, therefore shall they be made glad for ever with Christ.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Cornélii et Cypriáni solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Cornelius and Cyprian solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.

office.title: Ss. Cornelii Papæ et Cypriani Episcopi, Martyrum
